component.name: SIMulacrum
component.summary: Find your best World of Warcraft gear with SimulationCraft

description.p: A local "Top Gear" for World of Warcraft. Paste your SimulationCraft addon export and SIMulacrum sims your gear, gems, consumables and talent loadouts, then ranks them by DPS. It works for any class and spec, and runs entirely on your PC with no limits.

ul.li: Every valid combination of equipped and bag items
Upgrades and catalyst, using the crests and charges in your export
Gems, consumables and saved talent loadouts
Stat weights, a crest planner, the Great Vault, a trinket chart and fight styles
DPS history saved on your PC

description.p: SIMulacrum opens in your web browser. Keep its terminal window open while you use it.

screenshot.caption: A character pasted in with gear to try
